investigation-summary: How Godot 4.7's Forward+ renderer computes VoxelGI, followed through the source: a box of the scene baked into a sparse octree and a distance field, light passes that fill an RGBA8 3D texture and its mips, moving objects plotted into it, and the cones every pixel traces through it.

help-showBox: Draws the VoxelGI node's box (0 to 1 fades it in).
help-boundsStep: The bake's bounds step: 0 the box as set, 1 the power-of-two cube, 2 its cells per axis.
help-octreeLevel: The octree level whose cells are drawn (-1 none, 0 the root, 7 the leaves).
help-cellView: What the drawn cells show: 0 albedo, 1 coverage (alpha), 2 normal, 3 emission, 4 light texture, 5 direct light.
help-cutHeight: Cells are drawn only below this height, in metres, giving a cut through the room.
help-workedTriangle: Shows the worked triangle (one of the teapot's) and the boxes it descended through.
help-descentLevel: How deep the worked triangle's descent is drawn (0 the root to 7 the leaves).
help-satStep: The stage of the separating-axis test drawn on one child: 0 box and triangle, 1 an edge axis, 2 the box's axes, 3 the plane.
help-workedLeaf: Draws the worked leaf's 4 x 4 columns.
help-leafColumns: How many of the leaf's columns are drawn (0 to 16).
help-fixupStep: The worked cell's records in the readout: 0 its sums before _fixup_plot, 1 after.
help-focusRow: Which row of the readout is highlighted (-1: none).
help-cellX: The picked leaf cell's x index (in cells), or -1 for the demonstration's worked cell.
help-cellY: The picked leaf cell's y index (in cells).
help-cellZ: The picked leaf cell's z index (in cells).
help-cellArray: Shows the sorted cell array as a bar coloured by level, in an inset.
help-slice: The slice inset: 0 none, 1 distance field, 2 the light texture's mip given by mipLevel.
help-sliceHeight: Height of the slice, in metres.
help-edtPass: How many distance transform passes have run (0 seeds, 1 along z, 2 then y, 3 then x).
help-mipLevel: Which mip of the light texture the slice shows (0 the leaves to 7 the root).
help-extraLight: Turns the extra shadow-casting omni light (OmniLight3D) on or off.
help-lightX: The omni light's x position, in metres.
help-lightHeight: The omni light's height, in metres.
help-lightZ: The omni light's z position, in metres.
help-lightStep: The worked light cell's steps: 0 the cell, 1 the light vector, 2 attenuation, 3 the cosine, 4 the result.
help-workedLight: Draws the worked light cell and its vectors.
help-marchSteps: How many steps of the shadow march are drawn (0 to 40).
help-dynamicRange: The VoxelGIData dynamic_range that the drawn cells and slices use.
help-propagation: The VoxelGIData propagation used by the demonstration.
help-bounces: Number of light passes: 1 direct light only, 2 adds the second bounce (use_two_bounces).
help-workedBounce: Draws the bounce's worked cell and its cones.
help-workedParent: Draws the mip pass's worked parent cell and its children.
help-conesShown: How many cones are drawn (0 to 6).
help-coneSteps: How many steps of each cone are drawn (0 to 16).
help-workedPixel: Draws the worked pixel on the sphere and its cones.
help-pixelAzimuth: The worked pixel's azimuth on the sphere, measured from the red wall, in degrees.
help-pixelElevation: The worked pixel's elevation on the sphere, in degrees.
help-sphereRoughness: The sphere's roughness; the reflection cone follows it.
help-dynamicVoxels: Draws the teapot as a dynamic object, showing its plotted voxels.
help-dynamicX: How far the dynamic teapot has moved along x, in metres.
help-dynamicView: The view shown in the insets (0 +x, 1 +y, 2 +z, 3 -x, 4 -y, 5 -z; -1 none).
help-shrinkLevel: Which map of the shrink chain the light inset shows (0 the 16x map to 11 the coarsest mip).
help-dynamicMip: The mip of the plotted voxels that is drawn (0 to 7).
help-labels: Shows text labels on what is drawn.
help-cameraDrift: How much the camera sways while a timeline plays.
help-giDynamicRange: VoxelGIData.dynamic_range of the scene's node: the light texture's range, baked into it; changing it relights.
help-giEnergy: VoxelGIData.energy: multiplies the light the screen pass reads (dynamic_range × energy).
help-giBias: VoxelGIData.bias, in cells: how far along the normal and the cone the trace starts.
help-giNormalBias: VoxelGIData.normal_bias, in cells: the start's offset along the normal.
help-giPropagation: VoxelGIData.propagation of the scene's node: how much of the first bounce the second carries; changing it relights the texture.
help-giTwoBounces: VoxelGIData.use_two_bounces of the scene's node; changing it relights the texture.
help-giHalfResolution: rendering/global_illumination/gi/use_half_resolution: the GI pass traces one pixel of each 2 × 2 block into half-size buffers, and the opaque pass reads them bilinearly.
help-giRelightEachFrame: The lab's measurement, not a Godot setting: run the light passes every frame (Godot runs them only when the lights or the data change), so the performance panel times them.
help-voxelgiMix: How much of VoxelGI's light the room shows (0: the environment's alone).
help-interior: VoxelGIData.interior: 1 ignores the environment (alpha forced to 1).
help-viewMode: What the scene shows: 0 lit result, 1 ambient buffer, 2 reflection buffer, 3 the ambient's alpha.

hints-bake: The bake: the node's box, the octree it builds, and how one triangle goes down to the leaf cells.

hints-field: The distance field of the bake: its slice, the passes of the distance transform, and its mips.

demos-cost_subtitle: an update's work, and a frame's, counted from the code
help-costSplit: Split the view: the frame at full resolution on the left, as the values set it on the right, from one camera.
hints-cost: What decides VoxelGI's cost: the quality (cones per pixel), half resolution, the bounces and settings that relight it; the panel times each pass.
pass-voxelgiLightCS: For each lit voxel cell, adds up every light's direct contribution (shadow march, area lights) times the cell's albedo, plus its emission, into a buffer of cell light.
pass-voxelgiBounceCS: Adds a second light bounce: each cell traces six cones through the light texture already written, tinted by its albedo, and adds the result to its direct light.
pass-voxelgiMipmapsCS: Builds the coarser octree levels: each parent cell's light is the sum of its child cells' light divided by the propagation-blended child count.
pass-voxelgiWriteCS: Writes each cell's light, scaled by the dynamic range, and its coverage into its texel of the RGBA8 3D light texture, one mip per octree level.
pass-voxelgiPrepassFS: Draws the scene's depth only, with dithered coverage for fading objects, so the scene pass after it shades each pixel's visible surface once.
pass-voxelgiForwardFS: Draws the scene against the pre-pass depth, writing the direct light (plus emission) and object index into one target and the camera-facing normal into another.
pass-voxelgiGiCS: For each pixel (or each 2 x 2 block at half resolution), traces cones through the voxel light texture from its world position and normal, writing ambient and reflection buffers.
pass-voxelgiComposeCS: Combines the direct light, the sky's ambient and reflection mixed toward the VoxelGI buffers, and albedo into the HDR image, averaging MSAA samples and drawing the sky.
